keyFindings.description: A lower maxFileStoreGb (explicit, unset after a larger explicit value, or a smaller streamMaxBytes with diskSizeGb explicit) changes only nats.conf. nats-server v2.15.1 refuses a reload that decreases max_file_store (server/reload.go:1884) and compares every later reload with the running options, so every later users change (a user removal included) is refused too, while pulumi up succeeds and no pod rolls. Fix: roll the pods when the store limit changes (a pod-template annotation beside no-auth-user), pin it with a unit test, and correct README/nats-hub.md.

The advertiser container is /bin/sh -c <script> as PID 1 with no SIGTERM trap (tailnet_service.go:358-541), so the kernel drops the kubelet's SIGTERM and every tailnet host pod takes the full 60 s grace to stop. Fix: trap TERM in tailnetAdvertiserBody (keep the INFRA-560 copy identical) and pin it in the script test.

The component runs at least two listener hosts as one machine id, but neither README nor nats-hub.md says the listener image must carry INFRA-557's single-deliverer take-over; with today's listener two pods can both deliver from listener-<machine id> (INFRA-557 spec, item 1). State the prerequisite where tailnet.listener.image and the consumer's prerequisites are described.
